summary: Frontend-only end-to-end review of PropManage Digital Twin Next Stage II — Features 1, 2, 3, 4 + regression. Features 1 (Admin Catalog Materiale), 2 (Alegere Câștigătoare) and 3 (Concept în Pașaport toggle) fully PASS. Feature 4 (lead thumbnail) UI code is correct but could not be visually verified because no existing offer request in DB has a concept_render_url populated (the earlier offer-requested lead for verified concept 8b85e83… was created before/without a render). Regression: /admin/city-partners loads cleanly, no console errors.

integration_issues.flow: Feature 4 – Lead thumbnail with concept render
integration_issues.issue: SpecialistDashboard code renders [data-testid=lead-concept-render-<id>] gated on r.concept_render_url. GET /api/requests returned 49 items for the specialist, ZERO with a concept_render_url field populated. Cannot visually confirm the thumbnail UI on live data. Backend team notes this was verified via curl, but a fresh end-to-end (generate concept WITH render → validate as operator → prefer+request offer) is needed to produce a lead containing r.concept_render_url so the UI thumbnail can be seen. Code path is correct.

action_items: For visual Feature 4 verification, run the cross-account flow end-to-end with a concept generated WHILE design-render-toggle is ON (so a render exists), then operator validates it, then client hits 'Alege și cere ofertă' — this will populate concept_render_url on the new offer request and the specialist card thumbnail will render.
critical_code_review_comments: CityPartnerProductsPage.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete confirmation. This works but is inconsistent with the rest of the app which uses styled modals — consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency (minor).

SpecialistDashboard.jsx line 320: image src is built as `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}${r.concept_render_url}`. If the backend ever returns an absolute URL in concept_render_url, this will double-prefix. Fine for now since /api/requests/{id}/concept-render is a relative path, but defensive URL handling is safer.
PassportCard.jsx renders toggles dynamically from data.privacy_labels so any future keys will auto-appear — good pattern.

success_rate.frontend: Feature 1 100%, Feature 2 100%, Feature 3 100%, Feature 4 code-only (no live data), Regression 100%

The one 'TEST_QA Spec Rec' open lead is not from a concept. Existing offer for verified concept 8b85e83… was created in prior iterations without a render attachment.
